output.name: Tulmesk
output.myth: Nine went out past the Leeward edge and stayed fishing too long. Dark came down with no moon, and their hull broke on the rocks where the Unflown begins. They went under with the mast still standing. Under the wreck a shoal of small fish had been feeding on the scraps, and when the boat went down they did a foolish, kind thing: they lit their own bodies and hung beneath the hull like a lamp. Sil saw the glow from the Drowned Lantern and came down to look. Kael cast his net for the lights and, as always, caught nothing. Tirun, the Upturned Hull, lies keel-up to the west and knows that lamp; her own was lit underneath when she came home. The grey gull that flew south watches from the far corner of the sky. The lights are still burning in Vel. Old women say a drowned man can find the way down by them, and a living one can find the way home. If you see a shoal lit under a boat, do not net it. Tie your knots twice, and say the crew's names.
output.finding: Find Tirun, the Upturned Hull, then look a little under a hand-span (about 16°) east of it for the Lit Shoal.
